## Victorian Aids & Equipment Program (VA&EP)

The Victorian Aids & Equipment Program (VA&EP) administered by SWEP provides a wide range of assistive technology equipment and products through various programs to eligible adults and children. For more information relating to one of our programs please click on the links below:

- Aids and Equipment Program (AT) | including home modifications and wigs

- Continence Aids (CA)

- Laryngectomy Consumables Program (LCP)

- Lymphoedema Compression Garments Program (LCGP)

- Supported Accommodation Equipment Assistance Scheme (SAEAS) | Do you live in a DFFS or DH funded accommodation service?

- Vehicle Modification Scheme (VMSS)

For more information, you can access our booklet online by clicking here or request a print copy by contacting us.
